task_1_bcod_sim_model.answer: velocity_ned_mps is ground-truth velocity plus independent Gaussian noise; it is not computed by differencing noisy position
task_1_bcod_sim_model.implementation: packages/sensor-sdk/src/plugins/gps.ts GpsPlugin.#measure selects truth.velocity_ned_mps (falling back to truth.velocity_body_mps) and adds an independent Gaussian scaled by velocity_std_mps on each axis

attribution.later_history: no later commit changed or documented velocity_std_mps
attribution.assessment: 0.08 m/s is physically plausible for Doppler/carrier-phase GNSS velocity, but this repository does not establish that physical basis. It is currently an independently noised truth-velocity model with an unattributed magnitude.

gazebo_harmonic.provenance: NavSatSensor exposes SetVelocity in the ENU world frame. The simulator system supplies link/world kinematics; this is not position-differenced Doppler velocity. It is a sensor-plugin output backed by simulator velocity.

native_default_stationary_measurement.interpretation: the checked-in SDF config applies no native velocity noise

temporary_noise_diagnostic.configuration: temporary SDF only: horizontal velocity_sensing Gaussian stddev 0.08 m/s
temporary_noise_diagnostic.finding: the pinned runtime output wandered rather than producing independent 0.08 m/s white measurement error; the increments, not the output, were approximately 0.08 m/s

vrx.available_non_gps_velocity: OdometryPublisher twist, rejected as privileged simulator state
vrx.native_gazebo_velocity_fields: present before ROS conversion but discarded by the NavSatFix mapping; same simulator-kinematics provenance as Gazebo
vrx.conclusion: no acceptable directly exposed GPS-derived velocity source exists in the pinned VRX ROS interface

task_2_pinned_runtime_investigation.plain_answer: No existing source in either pinned runtime satisfies all requirements: directly available to the current interface, verified GPS rather than odometry provenance, and measured approximately 0.08 m/s stationary output noise.

option_a_native_velocity.advantages: Gazebo NavSat carries ENU velocity and SDF exposes a separate velocity_sensing noise model, conceptually matching bcod-sim's independent velocity channel.
breaks_or_gaps: ROS NavSatFix drops the native fields, requiring a direct Gazebo Transport consumer or a custom bridge for both external paths.
The native value is supplied from simulator world velocity, not derived from GNSS carrier phase.
The temporary pinned-runtime 0.08 m/s test produced wandering output rather than 0.08 m/s stationary standard deviation.
option_a_native_velocity.reruns_required: Gate A live measurement and all external conformance; bcod-sim need not rerun only if the native noise behavior can first be made demonstrably equivalent without changing its contract.

filter_estimate.important_correlation: successive finite differences share one position error and are anticorrelated; averaging N differences telescopes to an endpoint difference
filter_estimate.naive_white_input_estimate_not_used: ignoring correlation would incorrectly suggest about 752 samples / 376 seconds

option_b_filter_differenced_velocity.assessment: variance can be made similar, but transient response and disturbance bandwidth would not match bcod-sim. The approximately 7.2 s effective delay is materially larger than 0.2 s.
option_b_filter_differenced_velocity.reruns_required: external Gate A/conformance and external policy runs; bcod-sim would remain a different observation process unless uniformly filtered and retrained.

option_c_remove_ground_velocity.remaining_fields_shift: gps.fix_valid and all subsequent previous-action/time fields move two indices earlier; schemas, masks, normalization, checkpoints, and contract hashes must update together
option_c_remove_ground_velocity.what_breaks: all learned policies and measurements tied to the frozen 17-field contract lose comparability
reruns_required: bcod-sim Task 5/full 1.5M phase-1 training and its checkpoint evaluations
any phase-2 result produced under the 17-field contract
control/noise ablations used as acceptance evidence if they are retained
observation-path, portability, contract-hash, and external conformance tests
all external training, which must not begin before the revised contract is frozen
option_c_remove_ground_velocity.reason: the only immediately available alternatives either preserve an unattributed truth-velocity model with unverified external noise dynamics or introduce roughly seven seconds of asymmetric smoothing delay

recommendation.choice: Option C — remove the two ground-velocity fields uniformly and freeze a 15-field contract
recommendation.timing: decide and, if approved, complete the contract revision and bcod-sim rerun before cluster runs
recommendation.review_gate: No implementation is authorized by this artifact. Halt for review.

vrx_remediated_live_episode.finding: 2 Hz hold and approximately 0.2 s release latency were observed; observation code regression proves odometry changes cannot enter the 12 sensor fields

task_4_live_measurement_status.gazebo: native /gps was captured live, including velocity fields and 2 Hz cadence, but the standalone Gazebo harness still lacks a connected full TaskTraceBridge trajectory. Full 17-field no-oracle live validation remains outstanding.
